summary: Remove the PyQtGraph option and use VisPy as the supported plot renderer.

intervals.description: Inspect and remove the legacy PyQtGraph rendering option from the committed baseline.

results: Removed the Raw Data and Metrics renderer dropdowns from the Designer UI and removed their signal wiring.
VisPy remains the automatic desktop renderer. PyQtGraph remains only as an internal offscreen/OpenGL compatibility fallback; no renderer choice is exposed to users.
Updated the current README/Windows setup guidance, smoke/regression checks, and native validation tools to match automatic renderer selection.
Verified all seven modified Python files parse, Designer XML parses, git diff --check passes, and no renderer selector references remain in application code/controllers/tools.

Confirmed simulate_windows.cmd is tracked and present in this gold-standard checkout. It is missing only in the original checkout because of its local uncommitted deletion; that checkout was left untouched.
limitations: Unit and GUI tests were not run.
